facts.fact: TelQuel says the PLF 2027 announces national AI models GemMaroc (language) and IsMa (speech transcription) for darija, amazigh and Arabic, to be developed with the R&D lab launched in January with Mistral AI.
TelQuel says a protocol with Nexus Core Systems Morocco for a sovereign AI Factory (high-performance computing data centre, centre of excellence, innovation hub) is listed in the 2026 record.
